narrative.northStar: The Vigilant Guardian & Native Shopify Cockpit
narrative.overview: Safety Gate Monitor's design system unifies high-stakes EU regulatory protection with effortless, zero-friction merchant workflow. Inside the Shopify Admin, the interface feels 100% native: calm, restrained, and structured around Shopify Polaris design tokens and web components.

rules.name: The Triage Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Red (#d82c0d) is strictly reserved for actionable, serious safety hazards. Informational stats and passive states must use neutral slate or emerald trust tones to prevent alarm fatigue.

rules.name: The Native Surface Rule
rules.body: In Shopify Admin routes, all container backgrounds must inherit either --surface (#ffffff) or --surface-subdued (#f6f6f7) to guarantee visual unity with the host admin OS.

rules.name: The Eyebrow-Title Rule
rules.body: Major admin cards lead with an uppercase 12px muted eyebrow before the 20px headline to immediately establish category context.

rules.name: The Crisp-Border Rule
rules.body: Every surface has an explicit 1px border. Shadows never float unbordered in administrative screens.

dos: Do use Polaris Web Components with s- prefix for all interactive Shopify Admin primitives.
Do provide side-by-side visual comparisons between the Shopify product and the Safety Gate recall alert.
Do use explicit percentage indicators (overallSimilarity & imageSimilarity) alongside merchant recommendations.
Do maintain full keyboard accessibility and WCAG 2.1 AA color contrast across all severity chips.
Do localize all merchant-facing text through the 24 EU locale files.
donts: Don't use alarmist, panic-inducing copy; focus on proactive peace of mind, clear risk facts, and definitive next steps.
Don't use raw unformatted JSON or technical model debug scores in merchant-facing views.
Don't mutate Shopify product catalog status directly without merchant review action.
Don't mix non-Polaris UI component libraries into the embedded Shopify admin shell.
